notes.title: Robobo Updates Alert!!!
notes.content:
Stop your clock! Grab a seat! It's time for Robobo Update Report!

Since the game release, the Robobo team ( a.k.a. myself... =D ) has been working in a bunch of updates and fixes for the game. You can check them right bellow:


 Major and minor bug fixes
 Quality of life improvements
 Steam Achievements 
 Leveling up system upgraded
 Difficulty level has been balanced
 Some animation tweaks
 Game art reworked and improved 


Please, leave your review with any thoughts and everything about your experience.
Help the game become better and be sure to let us know of any bug or issue.

Now that we're done, wind the clock. Get Ready! Set! Go! Go! Go! ROBOBO!
Hope you stay safe, manage your time well and have lots of fun! 

Until next time! See ya! o/
